headline: European Natural Gas Prices Pass €90/MWh on Cold Forecasts and Supply Fears
summary: European natural gas benchmarks rose past €90/MWh after hitting €96/MWh, as forecasts for below-normal winter temperatures across Northwest Europe stoked heating demand concerns.
why: European gas futures serve as the regional benchmark for industrial energy, power generation, and residential heating costs.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: European natural gas futures surged past €90/MWh due to upcoming cold weather forecasts.
